description: Register a RecurlyResource wrapping the Recurly API v3. HTTP Basic auth (private API key as username, blank password). Every request pins a dated API version via the Accept header (application/vnd.recurly.v<version>+json). request() returns None on 404 (not an exception) so upsert-style existence checks can branch on it directly. Exposes a generic request().

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var with the Recurly PRIVATE API key.

name: Recurly Resource
